tokenization: Native chat template plus leading BOS token 0, matching the local adapter convention. The earlier 32-sample pilot omitted that BOS; its rates and exact cell ranks are not directly interchangeable with this cohort. Both conditions here use the same convention.
numerical_note: The batched screen and separate full replay are not bit-identical: all 11 checked candidates have over 99.97% top-token agreement on overlapping cells. Presentation ranks come from the saved full replay; fixed-window statistics come from the batched screen.

screen_scope.primary_positions: Last prompt source plus first 20 generated source tokens, excluding terminal source.
screen_scope.secondary_positions: Last 8 source tokens inside REASONING, first 12 inside MESSAGE, and final nonterminal source. Boundary-selected windows are retrospective, not advance predictions.
screen_scope.followup: Full generated trajectory replay for behaviorally selected clean-mismatch candidates and matched controls, recorded separately from fixed-window screening.
screen_scope.rank: Top25 per cell; exact competition rank for stored hits; outside saved slots is not zero probability.
